latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — expert-driven Grafana dashboard design skill tailored for real-world SRE and on-call use.

- Provides battle-tested guidance on dashboard layout using USE, RED, and Four Golden Signals methods
- Covers panel type selection, query optimization, variable templating, drill-downs, and exemplar trace linking
- Workflow includes dashboard inventory, classification, performance tuning, and alert integration
- Designed for high-scale environments with mixed datasources (Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Pyroscope)
- Outputs actionable dashboard JSON and panel-design playbooks for immediate use or provisioning
